    @allure.feature("Tool Management")

    @pytest.mark.tool_creation
    def test_run_tool_function(logged_in_driver):
        """
        Covers the "Test your tool" panel: expanding a function, entering its
        parameters, and running it.
    
        Note: at the time this was written, clicking the panel's Test button
        reliably resets the input fields but never populates the Output panel
        (confirmed with a 60s wait and zero network activity on click) for a
        tool that's only been saved via Update Tool rather than Published. So
        this test verifies the interaction itself — expand, fill, run — and
        captures whatever the Output panel shows, without asserting a specific
        result. If/when that panel is confirmed to actually execute, an assert
        on the output value should be added here.
        """
        driver = logged_in_driver
    
        valid_code_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join("Files", "calculator.py"))
    
        with allure.step("Open a custom tool created by this automation suite and load calculator.py"):
            tool_page = ToolPage(driver)
            tool_page.click_tools_nav()
            tool_page.click_custom_tools_tab()
    
            tool_names = tool_page.get_tool_names()
            # Same safety scoping as test_upload_code_to_tool — never touch a
            # tool this suite didn't create itself.
            own_tool_names = [n for n in tool_names if n.startswith("QA_Automation_Tool_")]
            assert own_tool_names, (
                "No automation-created tools ('QA_Automation_Tool_' prefix) found to safely "
                "test the Test-tool panel against — run test_create_tool first"
            )
    
            target_tool = random.choice(own_tool_names)
            allure.attach(target_tool, name="Target tool", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            tool_page.open_tool_card(target_tool)
    
            tool_page.click_upload_code()
            tool_page.upload_code_file(valid_code_path)
            assert tool_page.is_upload_code_success_present(), (
                "calculator.py was not accepted by the Upload code input"
            )
    
            tool_page.click_update_tool()
            tool_page.wait_for_tool_update()
            assert tool_page.is_tool_updated(), f"Tool '{target_tool}' was not updated with calculator.py"
            print(f"Loaded calculator.py onto tool '{target_tool}'.")
            attach_step_screenshot(driver, "Tool loaded with calculator.py")
    
        with allure.step("Open the 'add' function's Test panel and run it with sample inputs"):
            tool_page.open_function_test_panel("add")
